purpose: Freeze Memory class semantics so learning can inform Pandora without silently creating authority.

observation.meaning: Evidence-backed observation from runtime, provider, artifact, or other directly inspectable source.

inference.meaning: Model/statistical interpretation, prediction, or recurring-behavior inference.

owner_decision.meaning: Explicit attributable owner/admin decision. It may create a fact or policy, but only the decision itself can supply authority.
owner_decision.mayAuthorize: only when the decision is an explicit current instruction or valid scoped standing policy

authoritative_policy.meaning: Explicit policy with attributable owner/admin origin, scope bindings, validity, and revocation state.
authoritative_policy.mayAuthorize: only within the exact validated scope

fact.definition: Verified information treated as current truth until corrected or superseded.
fact.provenance: Exact attributable source locator and source type.
fact.evidenceLinkage: One or more durable evidence references or an attributable explicit owner statement.
fact.confidence: Required; uncertainty is explicit and never changes authority.
fact.supersessionBehavior: Newer authoritative same-scope evidence may supersede while preserving history.
fact.correctionBehavior: Append corrected fact, link correction_of, then supersede prior fact.
fact.promotionCriteria: Stable, useful, sufficiently evidenced, not low-value telemetry.
fact.retrievalSemantics: Prefer current non-revoked authoritative same-scope facts; retain superseded history for audit/conflict.

pattern.definition: Confidence-weighted inference about recurring behavior or likely future behavior.
pattern.provenance: Inputs and derivation window attributable without pretending the inference is evidence.
pattern.evidenceLinkage: References the observations/outcomes that support the pattern.
pattern.timestamp: observed_at identifies derivation time; effective_at identifies applicability.
pattern.confidence: Mandatory and calibrated; confidence decay/reassessment allowed through successor records.
pattern.supersessionBehavior: A stronger/revised inference supersedes only another same-scope pattern.
pattern.correctionBehavior: Append revised pattern; rejection/correction lowers or replaces future inference.
pattern.promotionCriteria: Repeated meaningful signal with enough evidence to justify retrieval.
pattern.retrievalSemantics: Use for suggestions/prediction only; never treat as permission.

policy.definition: Explicit owner/admin authorization or constraint that can govern execution within a bounded scope.
policy.provenance: Exact attributable instruction/approval plus scope, validity, and revocation lineage.
policy.evidenceLinkage: Exact approval/instruction decision and policy fingerprint.
policy.timestamp: observed_at, effective_at, and validity/revocation timing required where applicable.
policy.confidence: Confidence does not determine validity; authority is explicit and scope-bound.
policy.supersessionBehavior: Newer explicit policy may narrow/replace older policy; revocation takes effect immediately.
policy.correctionBehavior: Append explicitly approved replacement or revocation; never mutate inference into policy.
policy.promotionCriteria: Explicit owner/admin authorization after any suggestion/automation proposal.
policy.retrievalSemantics: Retrieve separately from advisory memory; validate principal, capability, operation, provider/resource scope, environment, sensitivity, cost, validity and conditional bindings before authorization.

procedure.definition: Reusable method proven by a verified successful outcome.
procedure.confidence: Reflects repeatability and evidence quality, not permission.
procedure.supersessionBehavior: Better proven procedure may supersede an older same-scope procedure.
procedure.correctionBehavior: Append repaired procedure linked to failure/correction evidence.
procedure.promotionCriteria: Demonstrably successful, reusable, bounded, and high-signal.
procedure.retrievalSemantics: Retrieve before similar work as advisory execution knowledge; current authority still governs actions.

failure_lesson.definition: Verified account of what failed, why, and what prevents recurrence.
failure_lesson.provenance: Incident, failed execution, correction, and verification lineage.
failure_lesson.confidence: Represents confidence in diagnosis/lesson, not authorization.
failure_lesson.supersessionBehavior: Revised diagnosis may supersede earlier lesson while preserving incident history.
failure_lesson.correctionBehavior: Append corrected lesson with explicit relationship to prior diagnosis.
failure_lesson.promotionCriteria: Failure is meaningful/recurrent/high-risk and the lesson is evidenced.

outcome.definition: Verified result of completed work, including success/failure and verification state.
outcome.evidenceLinkage: Exact result artifacts, tests, provider/runtime receipts or failure evidence.
outcome.confidence: Reflects verification strength, never grants permission.
outcome.supersessionBehavior: Later verified outcome supersedes stale current-state interpretation without deleting history.
outcome.correctionBehavior: Append corrected outcome after authoritative readback.
outcome.promotionCriteria: Material result with meaningful verification value.
outcome.retrievalSemantics: Use to inform decisions, procedures, failures and learning; authorization remains separate.

provider_performance.definition: Measured provider/model quality, latency, cost, reliability and verified success by workload.
provider_performance.provenance: Measured run/evaluation metadata without secrets or private payloads.
provider_performance.evidenceLinkage: Verified benchmark/evaluation samples and outcome references.
provider_performance.confidence: Derived from sample strength/recency and must be explicit.
provider_performance.supersessionBehavior: Newer representative measurements may supersede stale performance profiles.
provider_performance.correctionBehavior: Append corrected measurement/profile; retain old samples for audit.
provider_performance.promotionCriteria: Sufficient verified sample quality to influence routing; exclude noisy raw telemetry.
provider_performance.retrievalSemantics: Retrieve by workload/provider/model constraints for routing optimization, never as authority to expand action scope.

learningLifecycle.rule: Automation or repeated behavior may be suggested before approval; only an explicit authorized decision can create policy.

rawEventPlane.rule: Raw polling, transient runtime chatter and low-value telemetry stay outside canonical Memory.
